item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
Welcome to my blog!

My name is Abu Bakar, and I’m a Computer Science Undergraduate at the University of the West of England. I’m passionate about embedded systems, security research, and software development. In my spare time, I like to solve CTFs.

Here I’ll publish articles on:

  1. Hardware security
  2. My projects
  3. Essays on topics that interest me
  4. Walkthroughs of certifications, capture-the-flags, and other security challenges

You may remember my old self-hosted blog. Let’s hope that this one doesn’t die too!
